properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: MD5 ships in this build only as a transitive crate of the ethers toolchain (artifact checksums), not as application cryptography. Presence recorded; no first-party use to migrate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry for the ethers JSON-RPC transport stack (WSS) and archive tooling. Not used by the zkEVM circuits themselves.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The zkEVM's core quantum-vulnerable signature asset. Ethereum-consensus-mandated, so not unilaterally replaceable here — observable; any ML-DSA migration is an Ethereum protocol decision.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Posture-control sites recorded for completeness, but the compared values are public chain data — no secret-dependent timing surface exists at any of these sites, so the practical risk here is nil. Kept as inventory of the comparison pattern.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The repository's flagship quantum-vulnerable asset: every Ethereum transaction signature is ECDSA-verified in-circuit here. Migration is protocol-level (ML-DSA-class) and constrained by the Ethereum protocol — the circuits must verify secp256k1 ECDSA for as long as the chain requires it; observable here, replaceable only by the protocol.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS key-exchange primitive available in the shipped dependency tree; would negotiate only on runtime HTTPS/WSS RPC calls made by the ethers client. Migration to hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 depends on the rustls version the ethers stack pins, not on this repo's code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The dominant hash of the codebase, fixed by the Ethereum protocol — observable here, not replaceable; Keccak/SHA-3 is symmetric and only Grover-affected. Sites include non-security uses (mpt-test cache keys) as well as all consensus hashing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SNARK transcript hashing (symmetric, PQ-acceptable); also the EVM blake2f precompile (0x09) is routed in bus-mapping's PrecompileCalls enum and executed through the revm precompile dispatcher.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password-KDF provider in the shipped build (keystore decryption at wallet load); no first-party call site. Iteration parameters live inside eth-keystore, not in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The Go side's Keccak provider — same module dependency recorded under the algorithm view; the MPT trie hasher (gethutil/mpt/trie/hasher.go) is its live consumer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available-in-shipped-module entry: the primitive ships with the geth fork's crypto surface whether or not the oracle calls it; replacement comes only from go-ethereum upstream.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available-in-shipped-module entry (same sha3 module as the SHA-3/SHAKE128 views); observable, replaceable only via go-ethereum.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-support randomness only; no key material or production challenge generation. The deterministic XorShiftRng used for KZG setup/blinding in circuit-benchmarks is a separate asset reported as its own finding, not part of this object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Direct crypto provider of the Go oracle: keccak-based MPT hashing. Also the parent module of the sha3 subpackage entries (ALG-c9ef78a4/ALG-d0f975d5/ALG-cfa4b055/LIB-a5330b0f).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The workspace's only TLS stack: rustls 0.21 is pre-PQ — TLS 1.2/1.3 with ECDHE-only key exchange, no hybrid X25519MLKEM768 support (needs rustls ≥0.23 with aws-lc-rs). Changeable here by upgrading the mpt-test proxy's TLS layer; the URL scheme (https or plaintext http) is set by the WEB3_PROVIDER_URL environment variable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Duplicate view of the same go.mod require line — linked so a reader references the library entry once.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant: the mpt-test proxy relays RPC traffic and caches responses; rustls 0.21 offers no PQ group. Changeable here: upgrade rustls ≥0.23 with aws-lc-rs to enable X25519MLKEM768; the cache proxy is the only consumer.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: scrypt (memory-hard password KDF) ships with the ethers stack's keystore support; no keystore decryption happens in this repo's code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Weak-hash flags (CWE-328) apply to library presence; the consuming path is ethers-solc's compiler checksum, which treats MD5 as a non-security digest.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The secp256k1 backend for both the ethers wallet stack and revm's ECRECOVER execution in the witness generator; same curve as the first-party libsecp256k1/halo2curves stack (ALG-673c8f24) — backend library entry for that asset.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto-provider inventory: ring is the TLS/JWT crypto engine of the shipped image; ring 0.16/0.17 are pre-PQ-capability releases (no ML-KEM support).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Available JWT-signing capability through the ethers RPC client; unused by this repo's own code. Same logical asset as ALG-240215d0.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Weak-hash flags (CWE-328) apply to presence; the consuming path is the WebSocket handshake where SHA-1 is protocol-mandated (RFC 6455), not a security control.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak provider for the Go MPT oracle; parent module recorded under LIB-a2c61150. Live use confirmed via trie hasher.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MAC under the deterministic-nonce DRBG of the first-party secp256k1 signing path — a real consumer of HMAC in the shipped build, distinct from the hmac@0.12.1 entries serving k256/eth-keystore (separate inventory objects).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password-based KDF availability through the ethers stack; the only first-party exercise is test-wallet derivation from the hardcoded mnemonic (reported separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256/SHA-512 in the shipped dependency graph; PQ-resistant (Grover square-root only), so no migration urgency.
